xna-type.name: StorageDevice
xna-type.summary: Represents a storage device for user data, such as a memory unit or hard drive.

property.name: FreeSpace
property.summary: Gets the amount of free space on the device.

property.name: IsConnected
property.summary: Gets whether the device is connected.

property.name: TotalSpace
property.summary: Gets the amount of free space on the device.

method.name: BeginOpenContainer
method.summary: Begins the process for opening a StorageContainer containing any files for the specified title.

overload.summary: Begins the process for opening a StorageContainer containing any files for the specified title.

parameters.parameter: A constant human-readable string that names the file.
An AsyncCallback that represents the method called when the operation is complete.
A user-created object used to uniquely identify the request, or null .

overload.returns: The IAsyncResult used to determine when the asynchronous request is finished.
overload.remarks: After the container is opened, changes to the files within the container are cached until the container is disposed. For this reason, only one container per profile can be opened concurrently on the same device. If the storage device is removed or the Xbox 360 console is powered down before the container is disposed, any changes are lost. Call the Dispose method to dispose a StorageContainer .

method.name: BeginShowSelector
method.summary: Begins the process for displaying the storage device selector user interface, for specifying the player who requested the save operation, for setting the size of data to be written to the storage device, and for naming the callback implemented when the player chooses a device.

overload.summary: Begins the process for displaying the storage device selector user interface, for specifying the player who requested the save operation, for setting the size of data to be written to the storage device, and for naming the callback implemented when the player chooses a device.
overload.syntax: public static IAsyncResult BeginShowSelector ( PlayerIndex player, int sizeInBytes, int directoryCount, AsyncCallback callback, Object state )

parameters.parameter: The PlayerIndex that represents the player who requested the save operation. On Windows, the only valid option is PlayerIndex.One .
The size, in bytes, of the data to write to the storage device.
The number of directories to write to the storage device.
An AsyncCallback that represents the method called when the player chooses a device.
A user-created object used to uniquely identify the request, or null .

overload.returns: The IAsyncResult used to determine when the asynchronous request is finished.

overload.summary: Begins the process for displaying the storage device selector user interface, and for specifying a callback implemented when the player chooses a device.

parameters.parameter: An AsyncCallback that represents the method called when the player chooses a device.
A user-created object used to uniquely identify the request, or null .

overload.returns: The IAsyncResult used to determine when the asynchronous request is finished.

overload.summary: Begins the process for displaying the storage device selector user interface; specifies the callback implemented when the player chooses a device.

parameters.parameter: The PlayerIndex that represents the player who requested the save operation. On Windows, the only valid option is PlayerIndex.One .
An AsyncCallback that represents the method called when the player chooses a device.
A user-created object used to uniquely identify the request, or null .

overload.returns: The IAsyncResult used to determine when the asynchronous request is finished.

overload.summary: Begins the process for displaying the storage device selector user interface, and for specifying the size of the data to be written to the storage device and the callback implemented when the player chooses a device.

parameters.parameter: The size, in bytes, of data to write to the storage device.
The number of directories to write to the storage device.
An AsyncCallback that represents the method called when the player chooses a device.
A user-created object used to uniquely identify the request, or null .

overload.returns: The IAsyncResult used to determine when the asynchronous request is finished.

method.name: BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide
method.summary: Asynchronously displays the device selection UI to allow users to select a device to save data. This method has no effect on Windows.

overload.summary: Asynchronously displays the device selection UI to allow users to select a device to save data. This method has no effect on Windows.

parameters.parameter: The PlayerIndex of the user associated with the local port (input port).
The method to be called once the user has selected the device.
A user-created object that uniquely identifies this request.

overload.returns: An IAsyncResult used to track the progress of the method.
overload.remarks: Calling BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide when another storage device guide is on screen results in an InvalidOperationException . It is possible to trigger this exception if you call BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide immediately after calling EndShowStorageDeviceGuide (when the dialog box is still dismissing itself). To avoid this exception, avoid calling BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide twice, or do not call BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide until a few seconds after calling EndShowStorageDeviceGuide .

overload.summary: Asynchronously displays the device selection UI to allow users to select a device to save data. This method has no effect on Windows.

parameters.parameter: The method to be called once the user has selected the device.
A user-created object that uniquely identifies this request.

overload.returns: An IAsyncResult used to track the progress of the method.
overload.remarks: Calling BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide when another storage device guide is on screen results in an InvalidOperationException . It is possible to trigger this exception if you call BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide immediately after calling EndShowStorageDeviceGuide (when the dialog is still dismissing itself). To avoid this exception, avoid calling BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide twice, or do not call BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide until a few seconds after calling EndShowStorageDeviceGuide .

method.name: DeleteContainer
method.summary: Deletes a storage container without opening it. You can do this even if the container is corrupted.

overload.summary: Deletes a storage container without opening it. You can do this even if the container is corrupted.

parameters.parameter: The name of the storage container to delete.

overload.remarks: The string passed to titleName must be the same string used with StorageDevice.BeginOpenContainer . Usually a storage container is closed with StorageContainer.Dispose so that it can be re-opened with its data intact. Use DeleteContainer only when you want to delete the data permanently or when you determine the storage container has been corrupted. See the What Is Storage? for more information about using storage containers in your title.

method.name: EndOpenContainer
method.summary: Ends the process for opening a StorageContainer.

overload.summary: Ends the process for opening a StorageContainer.

parameters.parameter: The IAsyncResult returned from BeginOpenContainer .

overload.returns: A StorageContainer containing any files for the title.

method.name: EndShowSelector
method.summary: Ends the display of the storage selector user interface.

overload.summary: Ends the display of the storage selector user interface.

parameters.parameter: The IAsyncResult returned from BeginShowSelector .

overload.returns: Returns the storage device selected by the gamer, or null if the user cancelled the selection.

parameters.parameter: The IAsyncResult returned from BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide .

overload.returns: The storage device selected by the user.
overload.remarks: Calling BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide when another storage device guide is on screen results in an InvalidOperationException . It is possible to trigger this exception if you call BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide immediately after calling EndShowStorageDeviceGuide (when the dialog is still dismissing itself). To avoid this exception, avoid calling BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide twice, or do not call BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide until a few seconds after calling EndShowStorageDeviceGuide .

method.name: OpenContainer
method.summary: Opens a StorageContainer containing any files for the specified title.

overload.summary: Opens a StorageContainer containing any files for the specified title.

parameters.parameter: The name of the XNA Framework title.

overload.returns: A StorageContainer containing any files for the title.
overload.remarks: titleName should be a constant human readable string used to identify your title and generate a title-unique storage location. After the container has been opened, changes to the files within the container are cached until the container is disposed. For this reason, only one container per profile can be opened at the same time on the same device. If the storage device is removed or the Xbox 360 console is powered down before the container is disposed, any changes are lost. Call the Dispose method to dispose a StorageContainer .

method.name: ShowStorageDeviceGuide
method.summary: Displays the device selector UI to allow users to select a device to save data. Has no effect on Windows.

overload.summary: Displays the device selector UI to allow users to select a device to save data. Has no effect on Windows.
overload.returns: The storage device selected by the user.
overload.remarks: Warning Calling this function from the main thread of an Xbox 360 game will freeze the game. Use BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide instead, or call this function from a secondary thread.

overload.summary: Displays the device selector UI to allow users to select a device to save data. Has no effect on Windows.

parameters.parameter: The PlayerIndex of the user associated with the local port (input port).

overload.returns: The storage device selected by the user.
overload.remarks: Warning Calling this function from the main thread of an Xbox 360 game will freeze the game. Use BeginShowStorageDeviceGuide instead, or call this function from a secondary thread.
